# Intel Arc (A380 / A-series) - rename to nx2_switches.txt, or copy the lines you want into
# %APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt. Restart the emulator after editing.

# Task and mesh shader draws hang the GPU for seconds on Intel's Windows driver and draw white
# triangles and white holes in Ocarina of Time's foliage. Skipping them keeps the picture clean
# at the cost of some grass and leaves.
EDEN_NX2_NO_MESH=1

# The emulator's process yields less to background programs on CPUs with few threads.
EDEN_NX2_HIGH_PRIORITY=1

# Acquires that a release still queued for the second GPU thread will meet go on without
# waiting for it: fewer stalls between the two GPU threads on 6-thread CPUs.
EDEN_NX2_ACQUIRE_QUEUED=gequal
